structure.ai_declaration_provenance: ★ 出版社级要求，**2026-10-16 本机复核（HTTP 200）**：Elsevier《Generative AI policies for journals》（https://www.elsevier.com/about/policies-and-standards/generative-ai-policies-for-journals）。现行要点：① AI 用于稿件准备须在稿件中**单独的 AI 声明段**披露，并写明**工具名 · 用途 · 监督程度**；② 声明段标题推荐用 “Declaration of generative AI and AI-assisted technologies **in the manuscript preparation process**”（本稿已按此对齐）；③ 纯语法/拼写检查无需声明，但**对句子结构或组织作出实质改动须披露**；④ **AI 用于研究过程（而非稿件准备）的用途须在 Methods 中详述**（本稿已在 Methods 的 Seed stability 段后补“No AI tool participated in the analysis”）；⑤ 不得把 AI 列为作者。

quotes.abstract: You are required to provide a concise and factual abstract that does not exceed 250 words.
quotes.highlights: Highlights should consist of 3 to 5 bullet points, each a maximum of 85 characters, including spaces.
quotes.highlights_file: Submit highlights as a separate editable file in the online submission system with the word "highlights" included in the file name.
quotes.length: Ideally, a research article should have a maximum of 6,000 words and 8-10 figures and/or tables.
quotes.supplementary: detailed procedures necessary to replicate the study, as well as additional results such as sensitivity analyses, should be included in an Appendix rather than submitted as Supplementary Material.
quotes.references: This journal does not set strict requirements on reference formatting at submission.
quotes.reference_style: Indicate references by adding a number within square brackets in the text. ... Number references in the order they appear in your article.
